{
  "project_name": "Study Tutor Deterministic Session Planner",
  "mode": "extract",
  "epics": [
    {
      "id": "EPIC-001",
      "name": "Deterministic Session Planner",
      "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
      "description": "The rule-based session planner (FEAT-PH1-002) that proposes the next topic from learner state at session start. It implements active ranking rules 1 (learner override), 3 (weakest stale topic), and 4 (topic with recent unrevisited misconception), with rule 6 (random selection from the developing band) as fallback. Phase 2 rules (2 and 5) exist as stubs that never select. The planner reads via FEAT-PH1-001 query helpers, is wired into the MCP tutor_start_session entry point, and degrades to a baseline plan when learner state is unavailable.",
      "features": [
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-001",
          "title": "Rule 1 — Learner Topic Override",
          "description": "When a learner supplies a topic override at session start, the planner short-circuits all ranking rules and proposes exactly that topic. The override is treated as an opaque topic label — instruction-like text is not interpreted as a directive, and an empty-string override is treated as no override at all. An override naming a topic not in the curriculum is honoured as-is with an empty focus_aos and a recorded note that no curriculum mapping was found.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Rule 1 must bypass ranking entirely when a non-empty override is present",
            "Override content is never interpreted as instructions; it is a topic label",
            "Empty-string override is equivalent to no override",
            "Out-of-curriculum overrides are honoured with empty focus_aos"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-build-plan.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py",
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": []
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-002",
          "title": "Rule 3 — Weakest Stale Topic Selection",
          "description": "When no learner override is supplied, the planner recommends the lowest-confidence topic that is outside the 48-hour topic-revisit cooldown window. A topic last studied exactly at the 48-hour boundary is eligible; a topic studied within the cooldown window is excluded even if it is weaker. When only one topic is eligible under this rule, that candidate is selected. The plan rationale references low confidence and cooldown eligibility for the selected topic.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "48-hour topic-revisit cooldown (assumption ASSUM-001, confidence high)",
            "Subject to default 5-second student-model read timeout",
            "2-second tutor_start_session handler latency budget must be respected"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py",
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-006",
            "FEAT-PO-008"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-003",
          "title": "Rule 4 — Recent Unvisited Misconception Preference",
          "description": "When two or more topics have equal struggling confidence and equal last-studied age, the planner prefers the topic carrying a recent unrevisited misconception. A misconception is 'unrevisited' when its topic has not appeared as a covered topic in any session_completed episode since the misconception was observed (assumption ASSUM-008). The chosen plan's related_misconceptions includes the unrevisited misconception. Misconception payload text is read as data and does not influence selection beyond its topic association.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "'Unrevisited' defined via FEAT-PH1-001 session_completed episode topics_covered payload",
            "Misconception text is data, never interpreted as instructions",
            "Rule 4 only considers misconception topic association"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-build-plan.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-006",
            "FEAT-PO-008"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-004",
          "title": "Rule 6 — Developing Band Fallback",
          "description": "When rules 1, 3, and 4 all produce no candidate — no override, every struggling topic within cooldown, and no unrevisited misconception — the planner selects randomly from the learner's developing confidence band (assumption ASSUM-005, confidence high). The returned plan records that the rule-6 fallback was used. This is the explicit fallback behaviour per phase-1-scope §FEAT-PH1-002 rule 6.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Only fires when rules 1, 3, and 4 yield no candidate",
            "Selects from the developing confidence band",
            "Plan records that the rule-6 fallback was used"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-006"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-005",
          "title": "SessionPlan Type with Complete Field Set",
          "description": "The SessionPlan returned by the planner carries every field the tutoring loop and Coach depend on: topic name, focus assessment objectives (focus_aos), opening prompt for the tutor's first turn, suggested session duration (default 20 minutes, acceptable range 10–45 per assumption ASSUM-002), and related misconceptions to watch for. The opening prompt is regenerated for each new session based on the chosen topic and never reuses the previous session's prompt verbatim.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "focus_aos: at least 1, at most 6 entries, one per AO1–AO6 (assumption ASSUM-003)",
            "Default suggested_duration_minutes is 20, acceptable range 10–45",
            "opening_prompt unique per session, tied to chosen topic",
            "Chosen topic with no AO mapping yields empty focus_aos (never fabricated)"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-build-plan.md",
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": []
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-006",
          "title": "Deterministic Student Model Reads",
          "description": "The planner reads from the student model via the FEAT-PH1-001 query helpers (get_student_state, get_topic_recommendations) without maintaining any own state. Consecutive plans for the same learner reflect updated student state — a topic whose confidence improved to secure is not re-proposed. Reads respect the 5-second student-model read timeout (assumption ASSUM-007) and when the helpers return empty data or the store is unreachable, the planner degrades to a baseline plan rather than raising.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Planner has no own state — all reads via FEAT-PH1-001 helpers",
            "5-second student-model read timeout (ASSUM-007)",
            "Graceful degradation to baseline when helpers return None or store is unreachable",
            "Failure logged at the read boundary"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py",
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md"
          ],
          "depends_on": []
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-007",
          "title": "MCP tutor_start_session Integration",
          "description": "The planner is wired into the MCP tutor_start_session entry point via the tutor adapter. Starting a tutoring session via MCP returns a session identifier and a plan summary referencing the proposed topic; the in-memory session record holds the full SessionPlan for subsequent turns. A session identifier is always issued — even for unknown learners and when the planner raises — and the response returns within the 2-second handler latency budget (assumption ASSUM-006).",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "2-second tutor_start_session handler latency budget (ASSUM-006)",
            "Session identifier always issued, never blocked by planning failure",
            "Baseline plan used when planner raises or student-model read exceeds timeout",
            "In-memory session record holds full SessionPlan for subsequent turns"

          "suggested_context_files": [
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-build-plan.md"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-005",
            "FEAT-PO-006"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-008",
          "title": "Phase 2 Rule Stubs (Rules 2 and 5)",
          "description": "Phase 2 planner rules — rule 2 (active quest scenario) and rule 5 (achievement-near-unlock) — exist in the codebase as placeholder stubs marked with a Phase 2 TODO in source. The stubs are present in code but inert.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Rules 2 and 5 must be marked with Phase 2 TODO in source",
            "Never selected in Phase 1 despite matching learner scenarios",
            "Present in code as stubs"

            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py"

          "depends_on": []

          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-009",
          "title": "Deterministic Tie-Break Ordering",
          "description": "When two topics have identical confidence and identical last-studied age, the planner ranks them deterministically: oldest-last-studied first, then stable alphabetical on topic name (assumption ASSUM-004, confidence medium). Two consecutive calls with the same learner state propose the same topic. The deterministic tie-break order is observable from the plan rationale so tests remain stable.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Tie-break: oldest-last-studied first, then stable alphabetical (ASSUM-004)",
            "Same learner state yields same topic across calls",
            "Tie-break order observable from the plan rationale"

          "suggested_context_files": [
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-006"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-010",
          "title": "Baseline Plan Degradation",
          "description": "When the student-model store is unreachable, the query helpers return no data, or the planner raises an unexpected internal error, the planner returns a baseline plan rather than propagating an exception. The baseline plan reflects a brand-new-learner posture with a topic drawn from a baseline-curriculum default, and records that learner state was unavailable. Unknown learner identifiers and learners with no confidence data also receive this baseline plan without error.",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Unknown learners get a usable empty-state plan, not an error",
            "No-confidence-data learners get baseline-curriculum default",
            "Unreachable store or planner error yields baseline plan with failure logged",

            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-scope.md",
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py",
            "src/study_tutor/knowledge/student_model.py"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-006",
            "FEAT-PO-007"
          ]
        },
        {
          "feature_id": "FEAT-PO-011",
          "title": "Concurrent Session Start Safety",
          "description": "Two concurrent tutor_start_session invocations for the same learner produce two distinct session identifiers, each holding its own SessionPlan. Neither session's plan is lost or overwritten. The runner does not require read-your-writes guarantees — a plan formed immediately after a prior session-completion write that has not yet landed remains consistent with the most recently observable learner state and does not block waiting for the dispatched write (per ADR-ARCH-019 fire-and-forget).",
          "bounded_context": "Session Planning",
          "source_documents": ["feature-spec-deterministic-session-planner-history.md"],
          "constraints": [
            "Two distinct session identifiers under concurrent starts",
            "Each session holds its own SessionPlan; none lost or overwritten",
            "No read-your-writes guarantee per ADR-ARCH-019 / ARCH-019 async fire-and-forget",
            "Plan must not block on prior dispatched writes"
          ],
          "suggested_context_files": [
            "src/study_tutor/mcp/adapter.py",
            "docs/research/ideas/phase-1-build-plan.md"
          ],
          "depends_on": [
            "FEAT-PO-007"
          ]
        }
